title: AMC 10 Practice: Number of Divisors Ending in 1 — A Neat Trick
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on counting divisors with last digit 1 of a number with prime factors 3, 7 and 13, solved with a last-digit grid and a mod 10 trick. (Level 4 of 5)
How many positive divisors of 3^6 · 7^4 · 13^2 end in the digit 1? Vantee solves it two ways: a last-digit grid, then a neat trick that turns every prime into a power of three. You will see why 24, 25 and 27 are tempting traps, and get a new number to try yourself.
